information:
### Note: There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is not recommended for newcomers.

This competition only has blindfolded events. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events, please consider registering for [Council Bluffs Cubing Buff 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CouncilBluffsCubingBuff2024/).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
